svg.text: Does the frozen developmental component reproduce in repair?
Adult alveolar repair recruits the exact independently sourced developmental epithelial component beyond the identity, stress and labeling genes
excluded by the frozen shared-component contract. Its association in 24 mice motivates independent replication of that same component. Whether it
performs a developmental function during repair is a separate, untested biological question.
REPLICATION QUESTION - preserve the exact component
RIVAL - shared plasticity, labels or state mixture
WHAT THE READOUTS WOULD LET YOU DECIDE
Keep the frozen definitions and exclusions; do not
tune a new list after seeing outcomes.
Replicated RNA recruitment does not show that the
Current evidence: Association was positive in 24 mice. External biological-unit/state mapping remains held; functional reuse is untested.
